policy_limits: Manual .05-second ticks of actual scene/run/enemy/hero/defense rules. Automated policies, not natural player input or universal balance proof.
First-wave policy positions hero near the portal and uses no materials or towers.
Later solo policy grants unrestricted access to every target by following the oldest enemy with zero travel cost; it still loses.
Passive-only policy buys six walls using an explicit six-wood QA allowance; it still loses.
Mixed-defense policy receives 20 wood / 14 stone after the first wave, buys two Rapid / two Longshot / six walls, and uses ordinary earned gold. This does not validate gathering/travel pacing.
The separate paid-defense regression gathers actual material prices and wins; it is not a manual real-time playthrough.
